content: Let me verify the two trigger sites in `memo_service.go`:

h14.

**Computation site:** `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which delegates to `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`. The snippet (a separate derived property) is computed at serving time by `APIV1Service.getMemoContentSnippet` → `markdown.Service.GenerateSnippet` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83–90` and `internal/markdown/markdown.go:264`.

**Triggers (three):**

1. **CreateMemo** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` before persisting.
2. **UpdateMemo** (when the `content` field path is updated) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` after setting the new content.
3. **Batch rebuild at startup** — `Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) iterates all memos in batches of 100, calling `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` on each one to back-fill/repair payloads.
4. The **snippet** is computed lazily at read/serve time (every `convertMemoFromStore` call, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76`) rather than being persisted.

**Extracted properties** (defined in `proto/store/memo.proto:15–22` as `MemoPayload.Property`, populated in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356–418`):

| Property | What it detects |
|---|---|
| `has_link` (bool) | Content contains a markdown link (`[text](url)`) |
| `has_task_list` (bool) | Content contains GFM task checkboxes (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) |
| `has_code` (bool) | Content contains code blocks or inline code spans |
| `has_incomplete_tasks` (bool) | At least one task checkbox is unchecked |
| `title` (string) | Plain text of the first block-level H1 heading, if present |
| `tags` ([]string) | All deduplicated `#tag` values found in the content (set on `MemoPayload.Tags`, not inside `Property`) |

Additionally, the **snippet** (`proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:266`, output-only) is a plain-text summary truncated to 64 characters at word boundaries, generated by `GenerateSnippet` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:264–346`) which walks the AST, extracts text nodes (skipping code blocks), and truncates with `" ..."`.
